👋 Hola, I'm Corey

Multidisciplinary, full-stack product design veteran, with heavy experience in design systems and feature development across responsive web, mobile apps and CTV.

As a technical, collaborative, and innovation-focused strategist, I’ve become a trusted problem-solver who can confidently lead and execute the complex intersection of UX, product management, and engineering to provide solutions for business, user and customer needs.

I'm currently at CNN, enhancing our multi-platform Design System Language. Closely partnering with product and feature teams to enable better accessibility, enhance consistency, and accelerate speed to market. Currently laser-focused on creating a Figma to code pipeline and plugin that allows our team to publish, maintain and grow our design system from Figma, and integrate those decisions directly into our organizations codebase.

Prior to design systems, I worked on a number of net-new product initiatives at CNN+ across streaming, interactive community, and mobile apps. Before CNN, I worked at Bodybuilding.com that maintained a number of products in the health and wellness space, including an online retail store, educational materials, personal training mobile apps and health-related content.

I've also spent time at a number of startups and digital product agencies, on both the technical and marketing side, and even owned my own small-time agency at one point. My work has taken me far and back within design, and I look forward to what my next chapter brings me.
